title: ὄφις καὶ ὁ λίθος
learning_goal: Practice movement verbs ἔρχομαι, φεύγω, εἰσέρχομαι, ἐξέρχομαι with emotional verbs φοβέομαι, χαίρω, and the preposition κατά with accusative for throwing.
plot: Panda and Dinosaur play ball outside the agora until Ophis appears and scares them into hiding behind Emporos, who throws a rock at the snake, making him flee before Emporis gives them bread.

frames.text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος βάλλουσι τὴν ἐρυθρὰν σφαῖραν παρὰ τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Panda stands on the left throwing the ball with both hands toward Dinosaur
Dinosaur stands on the right with arms outstretched ready to catch the ball
The bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit flies through the air between them
motivations: Panda is happy and playful because he enjoys tossing the ball with his friend outside the market
Dinosaur is excited and focused because he wants to catch the red ball that Panda throws

objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Ophis slithers into view from the bottom right corner, his golden eyes gleaming
Panda and Dinosaur both turn toward the snake with startled expressions
The bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit drops to the ground forgotten
motivations: Panda is suddenly startled and worried because the snake appears unexpectedly while they play
Dinosaur is surprised and cautious because Ophis slithers into their game
Ophis is curious and sly because he notices the children playing and wants to investigate

frames.text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος φοβοῦνται καὶ φεύγουσιν εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Panda runs toward the agora entrance with a frightened expression
Dinosaur follows close behind, also looking scared
Ophis watches them from behind with his head raised curiously
The bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies abandoned on the ground
motivations: Panda is frightened and fleeing because the snake scares him and he wants safety in the market
Dinosaur is afraid and following Panda because he also fears the snake
Ophis is intrigued and patient because he watches the children run away

frames.text: ὁ ὄφις εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
positioning: Ophis slithers through the agora entrance with his bronze scales gleaming in the market light
motivations: Ophis is curious and persistent because he wants to follow the children into the market

frames.text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος κρύπτονται ὑπὸ τὸν Ἔμπορον.
positioning: Panda crouches behind Emporos on the left, peeking out nervously
Dinosaur hides behind Emporos on the right, also looking worried
Emporos stands at his stall in the center, initially unaware of the children hiding behind him
motivations: Panda is scared and hiding because he wants Emporos to protect him from the snake
Dinosaur is frightened and seeking shelter because he also wants safety behind the merchant
Emporos is busy and unaware because he tends his stall before noticing the children or snake

frames.text: ὁ Ἔμπορος βάλλει λίθον κατὰ τὸν ὄφιν.
objects: a smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple
positioning: Emporos hurls the stone with one arm extended toward Ophis, his face showing determination
Ophis recoils as the stone flies toward him, his eyes wide with alarm
Panda and Dinosaur peek out from behind Emporos with hopeful expressions
The smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple hurtles through the air toward Ophis
motivations: Emporos is protective and decisive because he sees the snake threatening the children and acts to defend them
Ophis is surprised and alarmed because the rock flies at him unexpectedly
Panda is hopeful and relieved because Emporos helps drive away the snake
Dinosaur is grateful and encouraged because the merchant protects them

frames.text: ὁ ὄφις φοβεῖται καὶ ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς ἀγορᾶς.
objects: a smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple
positioning: Ophis slithers away quickly with a flattened, defeated posture; he is half-way off the screen by the scene's end.
Emporos stands victorious with his hands on his hips
Panda and Dinosaur emerge from hiding with relieved smiles
The smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple lies on the ground near where Ophis was
motivations: Ophis is frightened and defeated because the rock scared him away from the children
Emporos is satisfied and proud because he successfully protected the children
Panda is relieved and grateful because the scary snake is gone
Dinosaur is happy and safe because Emporos chased away the threat

frames.text: ἡ Ἐμπορὶς ἔρχεται καὶ δίδωσι ἄρτον τῷ Πάνδᾳ καὶ τῷ Διναυσάρῳ.
objects: two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts
positioning: Emporis approaches from the left carrying bread in her hands
Panda reaches out to accept one loaf with both hands
Dinosaur extends his arms to receive the other loaf
Emporos watches approvingly from behind
Two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts are being offered to the children
motivations: Emporis is kind and generous because she wants to comfort the children after their scare
Panda is grateful and hungry because Emporis offers him bread after the frightening encounter
Dinosaur is thankful and eager because he receives bread from the kind merchant
Emporos is pleased and approving because his fellow merchant shows kindness to the children

frames.text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος χαίρουσι καὶ ἐσθίουσι τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts
positioning: Panda sits cross-legged taking a bite of bread with a big smile
Dinosaur sits beside him also eating bread happily
Emporos and Emporis stand nearby watching the children with satisfied expressions
Two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts are being enjoyed by the children
motivations: Panda is joyful and content because he has delicious bread and feels safe with the kind merchants
Dinosaur is happy and satisfied because he enjoys the bread and the scary snake is gone
Emporos is pleased and protective because the children are safe and happy
Emporis is content and maternal because she successfully comforted the frightened children
